meta.name: Battle music
meta.description: Battle music, played live in a SNES-style sound: sampled-chip strings, fingered bass, harp and a flute lead in A minor at 100 BPM, with echo. Two layers come in as the match gets tense: timpani, snare, hats and a driving bass once a tank is hurt or a duel is on, then kicks, crashes, brass stabs, racing staccato strings and choir near the end. The module is the earlier tracker tune, kept as the reference.
